title: Report queue — Niko
auth.signedOutText: The report queue opens with the bot owner's Discord account.
auth.ownerOnlyText: Reports filed from a staff email are read by the bot owner. Your account does not hold that role.
error.loadFailed: The report queue could not be loaded.
error.updateFailed: That report could not be updated.
page.title: Report queue.
page.body: Every mail sent from a Niko address carries a link its recipient can complain through. Reports land here with the message they are about, and with the conversation only when the reporter agreed to share it. Your answer goes out as a real email and is filed in the mailbox.
list.emptyBody: When a recipient flags a mail from the footer link, it shows up here with the reason they chose.
detail.messageGone: The reported message is no longer in the mailbox.
answer.label: Your response
answer.hint: Sent from {address}, filed in the mailbox conversation, and recorded on this report.
answer.notYet: Nothing is sent until you answer.
reader.pickBody: Reports are on the left, newest first. Opening one shows what was flagged, the reason, and the conversation if the reporter shared it.
